scope: Fourteen complete May MIDP2 RU splash/chat native and raw bodies; seven splash optimized bodies and seven explicitly absent optimized chat helpers. Five native/raw chat helpers match completely; BeginTyping retains its unused raw boolean explicitly. Whole raw/optimized callers with direct helper calls before optimization are recorded as witnesses; their differing bodies are not declared equal. This inventory alone does not prove behavior equivalence or complete rendering; legacy replay scope is source-ui-helper-replay.json.
